title: the ingestion pipeline (re-enrichment after catalog changes)

reasons.history-repair: Rules repairing enrichments of lago's history: recurring metrics before 2025-11-25 and pricing_group_keys before 2026-03-06 (pre_enrichment_check_service.rb:9-13, 40-59). Tanvo's enriched rows carry no subscription, charge or grouping column (architecture §7.2), so there is nothing of that kind to repair.
reasons.in-process: Tanvo re-enriches in process and stores the events with eventstore.Replacer instead of producing raw messages to Kafka (its writer keeps the first copy of a key, so a produced copy would be dropped), so the `reprocess` source_metadata flag of the message does not exist.
reasons.current-copy: Both readers (the PostgreSQL raw log and the ClickHouse ledger) return one current copy per deduplication key; covered by the libs/eventstore conformance tests.

notes:
## Files skipped whole

The other lago-api (`spec/`) and events-processor (`events-processor/`) cases libs/ingest does not port, by file, with the reason. Everything else in the files cited by the ported `source:` comments is ported.

### lago-api

| Source | Reason |
| :--- | :--- |

| `spec/services/events/create_service_spec.rb:72` (no Kafka produce when the job fails) | Same: there is no job to fail; a routing failure rolls the transaction back (ported as "rolls back when routing fails"). |
| `spec/services/events/create_service_spec.rb:88` (job cannot be serialized) | Rails/ActiveJob specific. |
| `spec/services/events/create_service_spec.rb:190` (produces on Kafka in postgres orgs) | Tanvo writes an organization's events in one mode only: ModeKafka produces, ModePostgres writes. |

| `spec/services/events/create_batch_service_spec.rb:395` (`api_post_processed: false`) | No `source_metadata`: the raw message carries `expression_evaluated`, and in-advance routing in ModeKafka always runs in the in-advance consumer. |
